Preserve 3GPP protocol version, 5G+, VoNR, DSDA, and Force APN editing based on your original settings when switching SIM 2 / eSIM (Slot 1)

On NSA networks, show 5G only while an NR link is active. Otherwise the status bar can show 5G on LTE just because the cell advertises 5G. On Qualcomm phones 5G stays for a few seconds after NR is released, so the icon does not flicker.

【Background】
On devices with dual physical SIM slots + eSIM (such as Xiaomi 17 Series Global), entering the dialer code *#*#7469542#*#* unlocks hidden menus under Settings -> Developer options -> Cellular Network / 5G+ Feature Center to configure advanced modem parameters (including 3GPP protocol version, 5G-A, VoNR, DSDA, and Force APN editing). However, when switching between SIM 2 and eSIM (Slot 1), the Qualcomm modem power cycles the UICC and re-enumerates, resetting volatile registers. This forces the 3GPP protocol version back to default R16 and wipes out your customized toggles for 5G-A, HOM (1024QAM), SWUL (Super Uplink), Full Power Mode, VoNR, DSDA, and Force APN editing.

【Mechanism】
When this feature is enabled, the module hooks into the telephony service (com.android.phone) to detect SIM 2 / eSIM (Slot 1) activation and carrier configuration events. The module continuously remembers your preferences configured in the hidden developer menu and system settings. During the millisecond window following slot activation, a multi-phase self-healing engine automatically reapplies all your original configurations to the Qualcomm modem and telephony framework (faithfully respecting your original settings: previously chosen 3GPP protocol version is accurately restored, enabled toggles are re-enabled, and disabled toggles remain disabled).

【No Reboot Required】
Because the modem resets its radio protocol stack during SIM 2 / eSIM (Slot 1) switching, reapplying your settings during slot initialization allows the device to negotiate with the network using your preferred parameters during initial RRC Attach. This eliminates the need to repeatedly re-enter the secret code to adjust developer options or reboot the device.
Active: Telephony hooks armed. SIM 2 / eSIM (Slot 1) transitions will preserve all features based on your original configurations.
Disabled: Stock behavior preserved. SIM 2 / eSIM (Slot 1) transitions will use system defaults.
